_comment: Voice config for the ElevenLabs narration. Run `python3 tts/generate.py voices` to list the voice ids available on your account, audition a few, then put the winner in default_voice.
_per_clip_voice_comment: Give an animal character its own voice here. Key is the clip filename.
_audition_lines_comment: The lines used to compare voices. Short, but covers a greeting, an instruction and an excited moment.
audition_lines: हैलो किशु मिशु! मेरा नाम है कोको। आज हम एक शरारती बंदर को ढूंढेंगे!
शाबाश! तुम सच में जंगल के हीरो हो!
